Query feature ages do not describe every historical reference tensor.

identity_anchor_diagnostic.scope: actual complete causal output identity links on common one-to-one IoU>=.5 GT-matched detector outputs; all anchors use strictly previous synchronized groups; raw identities scoped per scene; GT only post-inference
identity_anchor_diagnostic.limitations: Pure/mixed/new anchor categories are observational output relations, not actual Hungarian decisions or proof of appearance/pose/candidate-coverage cause. An ID without a past matched-GT anchor can still have earlier unmatched detections; these categories do not prove a new track was born. Unanchored categories remain separate, not automatically correct or wrong. Patch-center count uses exact official518/14 pad mapping; zero coverage does not imply ROIAlign failure. Past unmatched detections are not labeled. No GT used to choose online pairs, schedules or thresholds.
unproven_cause_categories: geometry failure as cause of identity change
